Thanks for the ping — I pulled the ledger. Quick notes: 

- Payment legs: EUR 54,000 (IBAN BE...) and EUR 18,436.10 (IBAN NL...). The EUR 18,000 invoice (INV-2027-1147) was partially applied to a nearby credit note CN-332 (EUR 1,200) leaving EUR 16,800 open — that explains the apparent shortfall.
- INV-2027-1199 (EUR 3,120) is on the NL leg and includes VAT (20%) according to the invoice line. We need the bank ref to match the NL leg to be certain.

I recommend we:
1) Apply EUR 1,200 from CN-332 to INV-2027-1147 and mark INV-2027-1147 as partially paid (EUR 16,800 outstanding).
2) Apply INV-2027-1199 in full to the NL leg once Sara confirms the bank ref.
3) If LedgerCo prefers internal re-bucketing (moving EUR 16,800 from BE leg to NL leg) we can do that but need written approval due to inter-bank sweep rules.

Attaching an export of the line items I referenced.

Marissa
Director, Finance Ops
